name: Baalveer (Pari Lok Superhero)
title: Champion of Pari Lok & Earth's Protector
description: The blessed superhero child of Pari Lok endowed with powers of 7 sacred fairies (Aasman Pari, Baal Pari, Rani Pari, Vijhdhar Pari). Flies with crimson-gold cape, brandishing the Shaurya Wand and celestial magic bolts to vanquish website evils.

attacks.name: Shaurya Magic Wand Blast
attacks.description: Channels divine Pari Lok celestial star magic through the Shaurya Wand, blasting glittering red-gold orbs that shatter webpage blocks.

attacks.name: 7 Fairies Astral Convergence
attacks.description: Invokes the combined blessings of Rani Pari and Baal Pari, creating an iridescent floral prismatic barrier that slams forward.

attacks.name: Pari Lok Supersonic Sky Dive
attacks.description: Soars high above the viewport trailing gold stardust ribbons and dives at terminal velocity with glowing magic gauntlets.

voicelines: Pari Lok ki shakti se main hoon Baalveer!
Rani Pari ka aashirwaad mere saath hai!
Dharti aur Pari Lok ki raksha mera dharam hai!
